steps.title: tu or vous?
steps.body: French has two ways to say you. This is not decoration: using the wrong one can sound rude or strange.

steps.title: tu or vous?
rows: a stranger, a clerk, an official
your manager or teacher at first

steps.title: In Canada
steps.body: Québec uses tu more quickly than France. A shop clerk may say tu to you after five minutes, which is friendly and normal there. As a newcomer, start with vous and let the other person offer tu. In offices, clinics and government services, use vous.
